Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 8
Code of Conduct
Every employee must act honestly and professionally with colleagues, customers and
partners.
Respect at work
Harassment, bullying and discrimination of any kind are not allowed. Complaints of sexual
harassment are handled by the Internal Committee, as required by the POSH Act, 2013.
Conflicts of interest
Tell the People team about any outside job, business or family relationship that could affect
your work. Outside work for a competitor is not allowed.
Gifts
You may accept gifts from customers or suppliers worth up to Rs 2,000. Gifts above this value
must be reported to your manager and are usually returned.
Reporting concerns
Report any breach of this code to your manager, the People team or the confidential ethics line
at ethics@northwind.example. People who report concerns in good faith are protected from
retaliation.
